demo_chips: How much does a new roof cost?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Christian Brothers Roofing at (972) 606-0504 or office@christianbrothersroofing.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Do you help with insurance claims?
faqs.a: Yes - we work directly with all major insurance companies for storm damage claims, including State Farm, Allstate, USAA, Farmers, Liberty Mutual and Travelers. In most cases homeowners only pay their deductible.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential roof replacements in Dallas-Fort Worth are completed in 1-2 days - an average 2,000 square foot home typically takes about 1 day.

faqs.q: Do you offer a military or first responder discount?
faqs.a: Yes - we offer a 5% Heroes Discount for active duty military, veterans, police, firefighters and EMTs, teachers, and healthcare workers.

pricing.summary: Roof replacement in Dallas-Fort Worth typically runs $10,000-$30,000 for most residential homes - a typical 2,000 square foot home usually lands between $14,000 and $20,000. Maintenance plans start at $299 a year, financing is available through Acorn Finance with payments from as low as about $25 a month, and Class 4 impact-resistant upgrades normally add $1,500-$3,000 (free through December 31, 2026). You'll always get a clear written estimate first.
